<ic>Permission to build an Embassy for the Sumar Republic plus funding towards the cost of the building.<br><br><i>Proposed by Bastion, seconded by Upwold.</i></ic>

===Overview===
* This motion was defeated

===Date===
* Winter 378YE

===Costs===
* Materials: 25 wains of Weirwood and 25 wains of White Granite ([[Embassy#Costs|Standard cost]])
* Labour: 12 Thrones
* Time: 1 season
* Upkeep: 5 Thrones

===Campaign Outcome===
* This would have allowed the construction of an [[embassy]] with the [[Sumaah Republic]].
